project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 3 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 19 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Ruyton-XI-Towns qualifies as a local detour through Tower keep castle immediately west of St John the Baptist's Church and CASTLE, REMAINS OF. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Ruyton-XI-Towns: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
